description: Validates each screen's layout specification is literal, traceable, and carries its own changelog

checks.description: Layout spec must exist for each screen in the inventory
checks.remediation: Run screen-generatelayout for every screen in screen-inventory.json

checks.description: Generated HTML/CSS must not contain placeholder language
checks.remediation: Replace placeholder language with literal, implementation-ready markup and realistic representative content

checks.description: Generated markup must not reference a specific application framework
checks.remediation: Per R-625, generate plain HTML/CSS only — no React, Vue, or Angular syntax/conventions

checks.description: Every layout spec must include an in-document changelog section, even on first generation
checks.remediation: Add a Changelog section per R-610; first generation should still record a 'v1.0: Initial generation' entry

checks.description: Layout spec must preserve its Screen's UI Model and requirement traceability
checks.remediation: Carry forward ui_model_ref and requirement_refs unchanged from the Screen's screen-inventory.json entry

checks.description: Layout Spec ID should follow the LS-[###] convention, paired to its Screen's SCR-[###] suffix
checks.remediation: Use the LS-[###] format from ui-prototyping-conventions.md, matching the owning Screen's numeric suffix
